title: Earth Courtyard House
summary: A rammed-earth family home organised around a shaded central courtyard that keeps interiors cool through the summer.

title: Sage Studio
summary: A compact design studio with lime-plastered walls, operable jaalis and a green roof terrace.

title: Stone Pavilion
summary: An open community pavilion built in local basalt, designed for gatherings, markets and festivals.

title: Farmhouse Retreat
summary: A low, long weekend home of exposed brick and timber that opens fully onto the orchards around it.

title: Clay Café
summary: A café interior using handmade terracotta tiles, reclaimed wood and soft daylight.

title: Monsoon Library
summary: A school library with deep overhangs and a reading verandah designed around the sound and light of the rains.
